jobs.title: Finance Master Data Specialist – Business Partner
jobs.description: ABOUT ERMENEGILDO ZEGNA GROUP Founded in 1910 in Trivero, Italy, the Ermenegildo Zegna Group (NYSE:ZGN) is a global luxury company with a leading position in the high-end menswear business. Through its three complementary brands, the Group reaches a wide range of communities and market segments across the high-end fashion industry, from ZEGNA’s timeless luxury to the modern tailoring of Thom Browne, to luxury glamour with TOM FORD FASHION. The Ermenegildo Zegna Group is internationally recognized for its unique Filiera, owned and controlled by the Group, which is made up of the finest Italian textile producers fully integrated with unique luxury manufacturing capabilities, ensuring superior excellence, quality, and innovation. YOUR MISSION IN THIS ROLE As Finance Master Data Specialist – Business Partner, based in Stabio, you will bring your unique strengths to the Finance function, helping us to create, maintain and govern Business Partner master data across the Group. You’ll work closely with the Finance Transformation team and relevant business and technology stakeholders to to drive meaningful results and shape the way we work and grow. More specifically you will: Manage the end-to-end creation, update and maintenance of Business Partner master data, initially focusing on vendors and suppliers, and validate requests for completeness, accuracy and compliance. Perform master data activities in the relevant systems, resolve data-related requests, monitor quality and ensure appropriate documentation and traceability of changes. Support the definition and implementation of standard procedures, controls and governance rules, helping harmonize Business Partner creation and maintenance across countries, brands and legal entities. Collaborate with Finance Transformation on the design, testing and implementation of automated request and approval workflows through ServiceNow, integrated with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Ariba. Contribute to the evolution toward a centralized Shared Services operating model by supporting process standardization, service levels, KPIs, documentation, user adoption and continuous improvement. WHO YOU ARE You bring 3-5 years of relevant professional experience in a Shared Services Center or Finance Operations, with hands-on experience in Master Data Management, preferably involving vendor, customer or Business Partner master data. You’re skilled in Finance Operations and Procure-to-Pay processes; experience with SAP Business Partner master data is preferred, while knowledge of ServiceNow and SAP Ariba is an advantage. You’re known for accuracy, attention to detail, problem solving and a proactive continuous-improvement mindset, and it shows in how you collaborate across functions and geographies and manage stakeholders in a fast-paced transformation environment. You communicate fluently in English. JOINING ERMENEGILDO ZEGNA GROUP Joining us means becoming part of a Group rooted in a rich heritage and guided by a long-term vision. Our people are central to this journey, contributing every day to a culture where craftsmanship, innovation, and responsibility come together to shape sustainable growth and enduring value. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic.

jobs.title: Store Style Advisor | Zurich Airport
jobs.description: STORE STYLE ADVISOR – ZEGNA ZURICH AIRPORT At Zegna the talents and passion of our people are the pillars of our success. Which is why we’re looking for a Style Advisor in ZURICH AIRPORT to support the team contributing to our proud legacy and helping shape our vibrant future. What makes you, makes Zegna The legacy of Zegna would not exist if it weren’t for the unique skills of every person on our team; the makers, masters, designers and doers. Everyone contributes. As a Zegna Store Style Advisor, you bring the human touch to the luxury experience. You are our ambassador, sharing both our rich heritage and collections and providing a service that is as personal as it is exceptional, and shaping their perception of our brand and ensuring our ongoing growth and legacy. What makes up your day Step into a hands-on, minds-on work environment where every challenge and opportunity helps you realise your full potential. You’ll learn the stories behind the Zegna brand, products and craftsmanship, use these to authentically engage with customers as you share our offering and build ongoing relationships with them to make them feel a valued part of the Zegna world. You and your colleagues are accountable for achieving sales targets for your store, executing the plans provided by your store manager, as well as using your own initiative to suggest alternative strategies. You are responsible for ensuring the store environment is always on par with what our customers expect of us and well organized. To achieve this, you’ll be involved in visual merchandising, packaging, stock room management, inventory, cashiering and reporting. What makes you, makes our team When you join Zegna, you join a team, working together to shape the future of our company. To be successful in this role you have a passion for style that you take with you no matter where you go, mixing casual and luxury looks to fit your active lifestyle. You’re curious by nature, adventurous and interested in technology. You connect with the innovative spirit behind the Zegna brand and know how to make it relevant and interesting when you share it with others. What makes you, makes our legacy Ermenegildo Zegna Group is founded on a proud history of craftsmanship and quality dating back to 1910, with a vision to ethically create the world’s finest textiles. Zegna has since expanded to ready-to-wear, becoming one of Italy’s most successful family companies and a global luxury lifestyle brand.

descriptionByLocale.it: STORE STYLE ADVISOR – AEROPORTO ZURICH ZEGNA A Zegna i talenti e la passione del nostro popolo sono i pilastri del nostro successo. Ecco perché stiamo cercando un Style Advisor in ZURICH AIRPORT per sostenere il team che contribuisce alla nostra orgogliosa eredità e contribuire a plasmare il nostro futuro vibrante. Che cosa ti rende Zegna L’eredità di Zegna non esisterebbe se non fosse per le competenze uniche di ogni persona del nostro team; i creatori, i maestri, i designer e i doer. Tutti contribuiscono. Come consulente Zegna Store Style, si porta il tocco umano all'esperienza di lusso. Sei il nostro ambasciatore, condividendo il nostro ricco patrimonio e le nostre collezioni e fornendo un servizio che sia personale quanto eccezionale, e plasmando la loro percezione del nostro marchio e garantendo la nostra crescita e l'eredità in corso. Ciò che rende il vostro giorno Passo in un ambiente di lavoro pratico, mente su dove ogni sfida e opportunità vi aiuta a realizzare il vostro pieno potenziale. Imparerai le storie dietro il marchio Zegna, i prodotti e l'artigianato, usa queste per interagire autenticamente con i clienti mentre condividi la nostra offerta e costruisci relazioni costanti con loro per far loro sentire una parte preziosa del mondo Zegna. Voi e i vostri colleghi siete responsabili per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita per il vostro negozio, eseguendo i piani previsti dal vostro negozio manager, così come utilizzando la vostra iniziativa per suggerire strategie alternative. Sei responsabile di garantire l'ambiente negozio è sempre alla pari con ciò che i nostri clienti si aspettano di noi e ben organizzato. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, sarete coinvolti in merchandising visivo, imballaggio, gestione delle scorte, inventario, cashiering e reporting. Cosa ti fa, fa il nostro team Quando ti unisci a Zegna, ti unisci a una squadra, lavorando insieme per plasmare il futuro della nostra azienda. Per avere successo in questo ruolo si ha una passione per lo stile che si prende con voi, non importa dove si va, mescolando look casual e di lusso per adattarsi al vostro stile di vita attivo. Sei curioso per natura, avventuroso e interessato alla tecnologia. Si collega con lo spirito innovativo dietro il marchio Zegna e si sa come renderlo rilevante e interessante quando lo si condivide con gli altri. Ciò che vi rende, la nostra eredità Ermenegildo Zegna Group è fondata su una storia orgogliosa di artigianalità e qualità risalente al 1910, con una visione per creare eticamente i migliori tessuti del mondo. Da allora Zegna si è ampliata al ready-to-wear, diventando una delle aziende familiari di maggior successo d’Italia e un marchio di stile di vita di lusso globale.

descriptionByLocale.de: STORE STYLE ADVISOR — ZEGNA ZURICH AIRPORT Bei Zegna sind die Talente und die Leidenschaft unserer Mitarbeiter die Säulen unseres Erfolgs. Deshalb suchen wir in ZURICH AIRPORT einen Style Advisor, der das Team dabei unterstützt, zu unserem stolzen Erbe beizutragen und unsere pulsierende Zukunft mitzugestalten. Was macht dich, macht Zegna Das Erbe von Zegna würde nicht existieren, wenn es nicht die einzigartigen Fähigkeiten jeder Person in unserem Team gäbe; die Macher, Meister, Designer und Macher. Jeder trägt dazu bei. Als Zegna Store Style Advisor bringen Sie die menschliche Note zum Luxuserlebnis. Sie sind unser Botschafter, teilen sowohl unser reiches Erbe und Kollektionen und bieten einen Service, der so persönlich wie außergewöhnlich ist, und gestalten ihre Wahrnehmung unserer Marke und sichern unser kontinuierliches Wachstum und Vermächtnis. Begeben Sie sich in ein praktisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Herausforderung und Gelegenheit Ihnen hilft, Ihr volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Sie lernen die Geschichten hinter der Marke Zegna, Produkte und Handwerkskunst kennen, nutzen diese, um authentisch mit Kunden in Kontakt zu treten, während Sie unser Angebot teilen, und bauen kontinuierliche Beziehungen mit ihnen auf, damit sie sich als geschätzter Teil der Zegna-Welt fühlen. Sie und Ihre Kollegen sind dafür verantwortlich, die Verkaufsziele Ihres Shops zu erreichen, die von Ihrem Shopmanager bereitgestellten Pläne auszuführen und auf eigene Initiative alternative Strategien vorzuschlagen. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, dass die Ladenumgebung immer auf Augenhöhe mit dem ist, was unsere Kunden von uns erwarten und gut organisiert ist. Um dies zu erreichen, werden Sie in Visual Merchandising, Verpackung, Lagerraummanagement, Inventar, Kassieren und Reporting einbezogen. Was macht Sie, macht unser Team Wenn Sie Zegna beitreten, treten Sie einem Team bei und arbeiten zusammen, um die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens zu gestalten. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für Stil, die Sie mitnehmen, egal wohin Sie gehen, das Mischen von Casual und Luxus passt zu Ihrem aktiven Lebensstil. Sie sind von Natur aus neugierig, abenteuerlustig und an Technologie interessiert. Sie verbinden sich mit dem Innovationsgeist hinter der Marke Zegna und wissen, wie Sie sie relevant und interessant machen können, wenn Sie sie mit anderen teilen. Was macht Sie, macht unser Vermächtnis Ermenegildo Zegna Group basiert auf einer stolzen Geschichte der Handwerkskunst und Qualität aus dem Jahr 1910, mit der Vision, ethisch die besten Textilien der Welt zu schaffen. Zegna hat sich seitdem zu einem der erfolgreichsten Familienunternehmen Italiens und einer globalen Luxus-Lifestyle-Marke entwickelt.
descriptionByLocale.fr: CONSEILLER STORE STYLE – AÉROPORT DE ZEGNA ZURICH Chez Zegna, les talents et la passion de notre peuple sont les piliers de notre succès. C'est pourquoi nous sommes à la recherche d'un conseiller en style à ZURICH AIRPORT pour soutenir l'équipe qui contribue à notre fier héritage et aide à façonner notre futur dynamique. Qu'est-ce qui te fait, fait Zegna L'héritage de Zegna n'existerait pas si elle n'était pas pour les compétences uniques de chaque personne de notre équipe; les fabricants, les maîtres, les concepteurs et les exécutants. Tout le monde y contribue. En tant que conseiller en style de magasin Zegna, vous apportez la touche humaine à l'expérience de luxe. Vous êtes notre ambassadeur, vous partagez notre riche patrimoine et nos collections et vous offrez un service aussi personnel que exceptionnel, vous façonnez leur perception de notre marque et vous assurez de notre croissance et de notre héritage. Ce qui fait votre journée Entrez dans un environnement de travail pratique où chaque défi et chaque opportunité vous aident à réaliser votre plein potentiel. Vous apprendrez les histoires derrière la marque Zegna, les produits et l'artisanat, utilisez-les pour engager authentiquement avec les clients que vous partagez notre offre et construire des relations continues avec eux pour leur faire sentir une partie valorisée du monde Zegna. Vous et vos collègues êtes responsables d'atteindre les objectifs de vente de votre magasin, d'exécuter les plans fournis par votre directeur de magasin, ainsi que d'utiliser votre propre initiative pour suggérer d'autres stratégies. Vous êtes responsable de s'assurer que l'environnement de magasin est toujours à la hauteur de ce que nos clients attendent de nous et bien organisé. Pour y parvenir, vous serez impliqué dans le merchandising visuel, l'emballage, la gestion des stocks, l'inventaire, la caissière et les rapports. Ce qui vous fait, fait notre équipe Lorsque vous rejoignez Zegna, vous rejoignez une équipe, travaillant ensemble pour façonner l'avenir de notre entreprise. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous avez une passion pour le style que vous prenez avec vous, où que vous alliez, mélangeant décontracté et luxe semble s'adapter à votre style de vie actif. Vous êtes curieux par la nature, aventureux et intéressé par la technologie. Vous vous connectez avec l'esprit innovant derrière la marque Zegna et savez comment la rendre pertinente et intéressante lorsque vous le partagez avec d'autres. Ce qui vous fait, fait notre héritage Ermenegildo Zegna Group est fondé sur une fière histoire de l'artisanat et de la qualité datant de 1910, avec une vision pour créer éthiquement le monde des meilleurs textiles. Zegna s'est depuis étendu au prêt-à-porter, devenant l'une des entreprises familiales les plus prospères d'Italie et une marque de mode de vie de luxe mondiale.
